# Decision Readiness

<!-- Generated by ordr from knowledge and graph sources. Do not edit; regenerate with `ordr project`. -->

Workflow: framing -> investigation -> evidence -> options -> decision-ready

Grouped by state, most advanced first. Within a state, higher strategic value comes first.

## decision-ready

### payment-reminders: Automated payment reminders

- Decision to prepare: Ship reminders to all plans, or only to paid plans as an upgrade driver.
- Current hypothesis: Scheduled reminders reduce overdue invoices without harming the client relationship.
- Evidence:
  - A beta with 40 accounts cut overdue invoices from 31 to 19 percent.
  - No beta account turned reminders off after the first month.
  - Reminder emails reuse the existing email pipeline.
- Open uncertainties: None recorded.

## options

### payments: Online invoice payments

- Decision to prepare: Commit a team to online payments next quarter, starting with the payment method that has the best evidence.
- Current hypothesis: Freelancers get paid faster when the client can pay in one click, and faster payment is the main reason they would upgrade to a paid plan.
- Evidence:
  - Median time from invoice sent to paid is 23 days across active accounts.
  - 41 of 60 churn survey answers mention chasing late payments.
  - Three competitors offer pay links on their paid plans.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether clients of freelancers accept a card fee or expect bank transfer.
  - Whether faster payment changes upgrade rates or only satisfaction.
- Supported by: payment-reminders (Automated payment reminders)
- Contains: bank-transfer-matching (Automatic bank transfer matching); card-payments (Card payments via payment provider)

### tax-reports: Quarterly VAT reports

- Decision to prepare: Offer a simple invoice-only VAT summary now, or wait for full expense tracking.
- Current hypothesis: A ready VAT summary keeps freelancers in the product at the end of each quarter, when churn peaks.
- Evidence:
  - Cancellations peak in the two weeks after each quarter ends.
  - Interviewed freelancers copy invoice totals into spreadsheets for VAT returns.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether reports need expense data we do not have yet.
- Depends on: bank-transfer-matching (Automatic bank transfer matching)
- Supported by: receipt-capture (Expense receipt capture)

## evidence

### card-payments: Card payments via payment provider

- Decision to prepare: Choose the payment provider and fee model, or stop after the concierge test.
- Current hypothesis: Clients pay card-payable invoices at least a week earlier than invoices paid by bank transfer.
- Evidence:
  - A concierge test with 12 accounts sending manual payment links cut median time to paid to 9 days.
  - The payment provider supports hosted checkout, so card data never touches our servers.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Who carries the card fee: the freelancer or the client.
  - Whether the provider's onboarding rejects many sole traders.
- Part of: payments (Online invoice payments)

### multi-currency: Multi-currency invoices

- Decision to prepare: Build multi-currency now, or wait until the invoice format is reworked.
- Current hypothesis: Freelancers with foreign clients leave for tools that support several currencies.
- Evidence:
  - 27 percent of trial signups mention foreign clients in onboarding.
  - Currency is the most requested feature on the public roadmap board.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Which exchange rate source satisfies tax authorities.
  - Whether the current invoice format can hold two currencies.
- Blocked by: e-invoicing (Structured e-invoicing compliance)
- Depends on: card-payments (Card payments via payment provider)

## investigation

### e-invoicing: Structured e-invoicing compliance

- Decision to prepare: Decide the scope and timing of compliance work before other invoice format changes.
- Current hypothesis: Freelancers will switch away from any tool that cannot issue mandated e-invoices once the mandates apply.
- Evidence:
  - Two of our largest markets have announced mandates for business-to-business invoices.
  - An open standard format exists and validator tools are free.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Final mandate dates and whether sole traders are exempt at first.
  - Whether we must connect to national platforms or only produce files.
  - How much the invoice data model must change.
- Related to: accountant-portal (Accountant access portal)

### bank-transfer-matching: Automatic bank transfer matching

- Decision to prepare: Decide whether bank matching is a separate bet or part of the payments bet.
- Current hypothesis: Most clients keep paying by bank transfer, so removing manual reconciliation saves more time than card payments.
- Evidence:
  - Support logs show 18 percent of tickets are about marking invoices as paid.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether open banking access is available in all countries we serve.
  - How often transfers carry a usable invoice reference.
- Part of: payments (Online invoice payments)

### receipt-capture: Expense receipt capture

- Decision to prepare: Build email forwarding for receipts, or drop expense capture for now.
- Current hypothesis: Freelancers record more expenses when capture takes seconds.
- Evidence:
  - In 10 interviews, 7 freelancers forward receipts by email to themselves today.
  - Only 1 of 10 wanted to photograph receipts in an app.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether receipt text recognition is accurate enough for VAT.
- Related to: mobile-app (Native mobile app)

## framing

### mobile-app: Native mobile app

- Decision to prepare: Decide whether to frame mobile as an opportunity at all or improve the mobile web view.
- Current hypothesis: Freelancers want to invoice right after finishing a job, away from their desk.
- Evidence:
  - Eight percent of sessions come from mobile browsers.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether mobile usage is low because the web app is poor on mobile or because there is no need.
  - Cost of maintaining two native apps with the current team.
- Invalidated by: receipt-capture (Expense receipt capture)
- Related to: receipt-capture (Expense receipt capture)

### accountant-portal: Accountant access portal

- Decision to prepare: Decide whether to interview accountants this quarter.
- Current hypothesis: Accountants recommend tools that save them time, which becomes an acquisition channel.
- Evidence: None recorded.
- Open uncertainties:
  - Whether accountants already have a preferred tool they push to clients.
  - Which exports accountants actually import.
- Depends on: tax-reports (Quarterly VAT reports)
- Related to: e-invoicing (Structured e-invoicing compliance)
